description: One-hour scoring rules for the ACTIVSg2000 dispatch game. Economic settlement is defined by the validated baseline DCOPF economic-profile artifact; the IT-service value is a complete full-horizon vector and the LMP matrix is stored in the NPZ artifact. These are instructional model outputs, not official ERCOT prices.

storage_cost_provenance.currency_year: 2022 USD for capital benchmarks; nominal instructional coefficients
storage_cost_provenance.basis: rounded teaching split calibrated to EIA and NREL utility-scale battery benchmarks
storage_cost_provenance.evaluator_mapping: The current evaluator charges storage operation per discharged MWh; fixed O&M is retained as a reference rather than double-counted.

it_value_provenance.interpretation: opportunity value of served IT load, not an electricity-market price

economic_profile_artifact.settlement_basis: locational price at the selected bus
